## Discovery & Translational Science

**Mechanistic features of novel molecular glue ternary complexes** [Science](https://www.science.org/content/blog-post/not-glue-they-thought-it-was)
- Analysis of small-molecule molecular glues that induce non-native protein-protein interactions.
- Examines structural dynamics and ternary complex assembly beyond canonical ubiquitin ligase pathways.

**Gut microbiome-derived 28-species risk score predicts long-term cancer risk** [medRxiv](https://doi.org/10.64898/2026.09.09.26362619)
- Metagenomic profiling of 5,997 stool samples in the Lifelines cohort and Dutch Microbiome Project identified a 28-species microbial risk score associated with incident cancer diagnosis over 10 years of follow-up (adjusted HR per 1-SD increase = 1.62, 95% CI: 1.44–1.82, p = 1.54×10⁻¹⁵).
- Discrimination confirmed in independent external validation datasets (1,879 cancer cases vs 5,341 controls) and validated in the FINRISK cohort.

**High prevalence of ACTH-independent hypercortisolism observed across cardiometabolic risk groups** [medRxiv](https://doi.org/10.64898/2026.09.11.26362842)
- Prospective evaluation of 216 participants using dexamethasone suppression and cosyntropin stimulation testing revealed an overall 7.4% prevalence of ACTH-independent hypercortisolism (post-dexamethasone cortisol >1.8 μg/dL with ACTH ≤10 pg/mL).
- Rates varied by disease state: 5.6% in normotensive controls, 6.2% in hypertension with obesity, and 10.9% in type 2 diabetes with obesity.

## Early Trials — Phase I–II

**[Biotech]** **Corbus Pharmaceuticals announces positive Phase 1/2 CANYON-1 data for oral CRB-913 in obesity** [@BioStocks / X](https://x.com/BioStocks/status/2099453622459220177)
- Topline results for daily oral CB1 inverse agonist CRB-913 demonstrated statistically significant mean weight loss of 5.0% at the 60 mg dose level after 12 weeks of treatment.
- Weight reduction showed no evidence of an efficacy plateau at week 12.

## Late & Pivotal Trials — Phase III

**[Biotech]** **Definium Therapeutics meets primary endpoint in Phase 3 Panorama trial of DT120 ODT in GAD** [STAT](https://www.statnews.com/2026/09/14/definiums-lsd-therapy-eased-anxiety-large-trial-psychedelic/) / [@BioStocks / X](https://x.com/BioStocks/status/2099453331697439197)
- Phase 3 Panorama study evaluating orally disintegrating LSD formulation DT120 ODT (100 µg) in generalized anxiety disorder met primary and key secondary endpoints.
- Least-squares mean change in Hamilton Anxiety Rating Scale (HAM-A) at Week 12 was -9.8 for DT120 vs -4.7 for placebo (placebo-adjusted difference -5.1, p < 0.0001).
- Pre-NDA meeting with FDA scheduled for Q4, with NDA filing planned for 1H 2027.

**[Biotech]** **Summit Therapeutics reports positive overall survival for ivonescimab in Harmoni-2 trial** [@JacobPlieth / X](https://x.com/JacobPlieth/status/2099122205858611543)
- Monotherapy ivonescimab (PD-1/VEGF bispecific antibody) demonstrated superior overall survival vs pembrolizumab (hazard ratio = 0.73) in first-line PD-L1-positive non-small cell lung cancer.
- Prespecified second interim OS analysis occurred at 234 events with a one-sided significance threshold of α = 0.0141.

**[Biotech]** **BioNTech presents updated Phase 3 PRESERVE-003 data for gotistobart in NSCLC** [@BioStocks / X](https://x.com/BioStocks/status/2099443782655586738)
- Updated results from Phase 3 PRESERVE-003 trial show gotistobart nearly doubled median overall survival compared with standard-of-care chemotherapy in previously treated advanced squamous NSCLC.

**[Big Pharma]** **AstraZeneca oral breast cancer candidate fails pivotal trial** [STAT](https://www.statnews.com/pharmalot/2026/09/14/another-astrazeneca-trial-failure-novo-name-change/)
- AstraZeneca disclosed that an investigational breast cancer pill failed to achieve its primary endpoint in a pivotal Phase 3 trial evaluating first-line therapy in advanced disease.

**[Big Pharma]** **AstraZeneca updates 8-year overall survival landmark for osimertinib in ADAURA trial** [PubMed](https://pubmed.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/42732874/)
- Exploratory 8-year overall survival landmark update published from the Phase 3 ADAURA trial evaluating adjuvant Tagrisso (osimertinib) in resected EGFR-mutated Stage IB–IIIA non-small cell lung cancer.

**[Biotech]** **Immunocore completes target enrollment in registrational TEBE-AM trial** [@BioStocks / X](https://x.com/BioStocks/status/2099453991629291912)
- Reached target enrollment in the registrational TEBE-AM study evaluating KIMMTRAK (tebentafusp) in previously treated advanced melanoma.
- Topline overall survival data expected as early as end of year.

**[Biotech]** **High AE discontinuation rate reported for zipalertinib in Phase 3 Rezilient-3 study** [@JacobPlieth / X](https://x.com/JacobPlieth/status/2099422493920399628)
- Data presented at WCLC demonstrated a 17% treatment discontinuation rate due to drug-specific adverse events with zipalertinib in the Phase 3 Rezilient-3 trial in EGFR exon 20 insertion NSCLC.

## Regulatory & Approvals

**[Biotech]** **FDA approves Scholar Rock's Isembyld (apitegromab) for spinal muscular atrophy** [BioPharma Dive](https://www.biopharmadive.com/news/scholar-rock-sma-drug-isemblyd-fda-approve/830232/)
- FDA approved apitegromab (to be marketed as Isembyld), a monoclonal antibody inhibitor of latent myostatin activation, for use alongside standard targeted therapies in adults and children aged ≥2 years with SMA.
- Annual list price set at approximately $310,000 per patient, varying by body weight and insurance coverage.

**Centric Compounding recalls multidose injectable products due to elevated endotoxin levels** [FDA](http://www.fda.gov/safety/recalls-market-withdrawals-safety-alerts/centric-compounding-issues-nationwide-recall-glutathione-myers-cocktail-and-tri-immune-boost-due)
- Voluntary nationwide recall initiated for 6 lots of compounded Glutathione (200 mg/mL), Myer’s Cocktail, and Tri-Immune Boost multidose vials following discovery of raw material API with elevated endotoxins.
- Nine adverse reaction reports received involving fever, chills, nausea, vomiting, chest pain, and headache.

## Business & Strategy

**[Big Pharma]** **Novo Nordisk rebrands corporate identity to Novo** [STAT](https://www.statnews.com/2026/09/14/novo-nordisk-company-rebrand-obesity-diabetes/) / [@BioStocks / X](https://x.com/BioStocks/status/2099432261582012665)
- Novo Nordisk announced a corporate rebranding, officially shortening its commercial name to Novo to signal a more focused operational strategy in obesity and diabetes.

**[Biotech]** **Tyra Biosciences prices $400 million equity and warrant offering** [@JacobPlieth / X](https://x.com/JacobPlieth/status/2099450875399856590) / [@BioStocks / X](https://x.com/BioStocks/status/2099449821341905080)
- Announced and priced a $400 million public offering of common stock and pre-funded warrants at a price of $22.03 per share.

**[Biotech]** **Cellectis pivots to in vivo gene editing and discontinues clinical CAR-T programs** [@BioStocks / X](https://x.com/BioStocks/status/2099439336173301927)
- Strategic transformation announced to prioritize in vivo gene editing technology.
- Exiting clinical development of ex vivo CAR-T cell therapy candidates Lasme-Cel and Eti-Cel.

## Public Health & Policy

**Ohio policy proposals address school exclusion during active measles outbreaks** [Science-Based Medicine](http://sciencebasedmedicine.org/making-measles-great-again-in-ohio/)
- Legislative and policy measures under discussion in Ohio aim to prevent schools from excluding unvaccinated students during ongoing measles outbreaks.

**Pennsylvania reports third measles death as regional outbreak persists** [STAT](https://www.statnews.com/2026/09/14/health-enws-pennsylvania-records-third-measles-related-death-amid-outbreak/)
- Health authorities confirmed a third measles-related death in Pennsylvania amidst a localized outbreak.

**Analysis indicates secret pharma deals could reduce savings from proposed pricing rules** [STAT](https://www.statnews.com/pharmalot/2026/09/13/trump-secretive-pharma-deals-undermine-most-favored-nation-pricing/)
- Policy analysis reveals that non-public executive agreements with pharmaceutical companies could substantially erode projected cost savings from proposed "most-favored nation" drug pricing models.

**Updated surveillance study doubles estimated total Lyme disease incidence in England** [medRxiv](https://doi.org/10.64898/2026.09.11.26362844)
- Seasonal time-series modeling of UK reference lab and primary care data (2013–2024) indicates primary care diagnoses rose by ~498 cases annually despite flat laboratory case counts, raising the calculated multiplication factor for total estimated acute cases from 2.35 to 6.20.

**Hospital executives report allocation barriers in $50 billion rural health fund** [STAT](https://www.statnews.com/2026/09/14/rural-health-transformation-fund-skepticism-shortcomings-part-5-unraveled-series/)
- Rural hospital leaders voice concerns over fine-print regulatory requirements and implementation limits in the federal $50 billion Rural Health Transformation Fund.

- Biology & Health
    - [Peptides with HUGE Cardiovascular Impact!](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=e2_9mHtWwBQ) -- Physionic
        - Reviews major outcome trials (including SUSTAIN-6, REWIND, Harmony Outcomes, and SELECT) evaluating GLP-1 receptor agonist peptides—such as semaglutide, dulaglutide, and albiglutide—for cardiovascular risk reduction in patients with type 2 diabetes and obesity.
        - Analyzes clinical evidence on subclinical atherosclerosis, detailing how agents like liraglutide, exenatide, and semaglutide affect carotid intima-media thickness (CIMT).
        - Examines coronary artery imaging data regarding structural atheroma changes, including coronary plaque delipidation, regression, and fibrous plaque progression in statin-treated diabetic populations.
    - [407 ‒ Preventing cardiovascular and Alzheimer’s disease: lowering LDL early, APOE4, and more](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=EuPcbF9YVTo) -- Peter Attia MD
        - Re-evaluates cardiovascular disease prevention strategies by focusing on early, lifelong lowering of causal lipid drivers (LDL-C and apoB) rather than short-term risk prediction models.
        - Details the mechanism of CETP inhibition and contrasts earlier failed agents (torcetrapib, dalcetrapib, evacetrapib) with obicetrapib, which primarily drives potent lowering of LDL-C, apoB, and Lp(a).
        - Summarizes phase 2 and phase 3 clinical trial data for obicetrapib (including ROSE, BROOKLYN, BROADWAY, TANDEM, and PREVAIL) as an oral alternative or adjunct to high-dose statin therapy.
        - Explores the neurological rationale for obicetrapib in Alzheimer's disease targeting APOE4 carriage, brain cholesterol metabolism, astrocyte cholesterol efflux, and CSF biomarkers like p-tau 217.
        - Examines challenges in lipid management and neurology, including DHA brain delivery across the blood-brain barrier, statin-associated glycemic signals, and modernizing clinical trial design using AI.
